# Invoices

Go to **Settings** > **Billing** > **Invoices** to see every invoice for the account.

The list shows the newest invoice first. Each row has the invoice number, the amount and a [[Order statuses|status]] badge.

## Download an invoice

1. Open the invoice from the list.
2. Click **Download PDF** in the top bar.

Invoices older than 24 months are archived. Ask [[Acme]] support to restore one. #billing
